events.title: Node.js 16 released
events.summary: Node.js 16.0.0 shipped on April 20, 2021 with Apple Silicon builds, stable timers/promises APIs, and V8 9.0.
events.about: Node 16 became LTS in October 2021 — bridging the gap before Node 18's fetch API. Apple Silicon native binaries improved M1 Mac development; `timers/promises` standardized async sleep and scheduling in the stdlib.

narrative.whyChosen: Node 16 was the LTS line during the post-pandemic JavaScript tooling surge.
narrative.whyImportant: Apple Silicon support made Node viable on the new Mac developer default.
narrative.problemSolved: Rosetta-translated Node on M1 Macs was slow and unreliable for daily development.
